title: The Debt of the Crown
text: Collectors in drowned livery have come up the river road with a writ sealed in black wax: the old King's unpaid debts, with three hundred Years of interest. They do not eat or sleep. They stand in the square waiting for gold, and the longer they wait, the more of the square is under water.

temptation.label: Pay your share in the King's own coin, from the vault you should not have.
temptation.text: The drowned collectors take it with a bow. They will tell the King who had his coin.

triumph.text: The debt is paid in full. The collectors walk back into the river, while the King's black seal on the writ crumbles to wet ash. Somewhere far away, something is disappointed.

holds.text: The debt is paid, near enough. The collectors bow and go, taking the toll-keeper with them; nobody saw him agree to it.

falters.text: The payment falls short, so the collectors take the balance in kind. A recruit from one House walks into the river, smiling.

calamity.text: The city defaults. The collectors stay until the square drowns, and every House's ledger turns black in a night. In the Barrows, the old King's drowned court begins to wake.
